title: Wireless Charging Pad Usability and Charging Performance
summary: Feedback on the G60 wireless charging pad centers on unreliable charging and awkward pad layout, while many other mentions are feature requests or complaints stated without clear sentiment labeling.

positive.summary: One positive review says the wireless charging pad is appreciated as a feature.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe inconsistent or very weak charging, difficult phone positioning, awkward placement or sizing, storage compromises, and occasional buzzing or vibration from the pad.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention poor charging, dissatisfaction with the layout, and requests for faster charging, more space, or multiple trays, but the sample does not provide enough detail to classify these consistently into a clearer sentiment group.

limitations: Most topic reviews are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a more precise sentiment characterization.
The sampled fragments emphasize charging effectiveness and layout concerns, but they may not cover all wireless charging pad issues mentioned across the full topic.
Some undetermined fragments read like complaints or feature requests, but the provided labels prevent reassigning them to other sentiment categories.
